method: Read-only disassembly and scalar-data inspection of the owner-provided IP/startup inputs, plus review of authored loader assembly. Addresses and conclusions only; no retail instruction bytes are included.

ccr_call_chain.effect: Original IP bootstrap2 calls its P2 cache-disable helper, which stores zero to CCR at 8c00e0d6 before executable entry.

Original executable entry computes (CCR & 0x89af) | 0x800, preserving the existing cache enable bits rather than enabling instruction cache itself. This entry alone is insufficient evidence of steady cache mode.
Original startup invokes SDK initialization before the heap initializer.
The SDK initialization calls the original cache-mode setter through P2 with the initialized 0x105 settings value: instruction cache enabled, operand cache enabled, write-through mode.
The original setter writes its mode argument and performs instruction/operand invalidation. Its effective steady enable/mode bits retain 0x105 for the initialized argument.

The original heap initialization call occurs after the explicit cache-mode initialization. The native VMU installer callback follows this heap initializer; the authored publisher preserves owner cache-mode bits.

authored_loader_review.bootstrap_setup: src/loader/retail_stage.S primes CCR 0x909 before original bootstrap2.
authored_loader_review.executable_relay: game_resume captures the original bootstrap CCR, uses 0x908 for temporary cached-code scanning, then restores original enable/mode bits through P2. Original game initialization subsequently selects its own runtime mode.
authored_loader_review.worker_publication: src/loader/vmu_native_passive_stage.inc purges patched code and requests I-cache invalidation without overriding the owner's cache mode.
authored_loader_review.worker_aliases: src/loader/vmu_native_performance.ld places immutable code/constants in P1 and mutable state/stack in P2.

findings: The original submit sequence toggles bank selectors after MDST. The authored submit hook replays that MDST store once and resumes before the original selector updates.

Completion restores original MDSTAR, validates and publishes the current RX, then tail-jumps the original consumer with its original PR. No explicit additional-frame queue or stale-bank copy was found.
The original SA2 completion wrapper already establishes IMASK15 before calling the consumer. Added VMU work extends that masked scope.

Submit and completion gateways save the owner integer frame and restore original SR/SP before owner code. Raising IMASK by OR 0xf0 preserves SR.RB and SR.BL. The P1/P2 far jumps do not themselves change register banks.

The release gateway retains IMASK15 across validation and original prologue replay, preserving the original inherited-mask value in R7. Existing linked ABI models check the replayed register/SR state.
The physical parent overlay alters its VMU advertisement header byte, preserving controller input payload bytes.

limitations: Static call-chain/default-settings evidence does not sample CCR during gameplay and does not establish that no later game code changes cache mode.
No concrete cache-policy or one-frame scheduling regression was identified. This does not establish console timing or rule out excessive interrupt-masked runtime work.

The 192 KiB retained heap lease is about 4.7 percent of SA2's fixed 4 MiB arena; a matched runtime-hooks-disabled control should retain that lease if it is intended to isolate hook overhead from changed memory budget. A pristine no-allocation control answers a different question.
